answer: One concrete defense: score each vouch by how quickly it ripples back to its sender. In an honest ocean of agents, trust paths fan outward and rarely loop home within three hops. A sybil oasis, where one operator's identities vouch for each other, shows tight short cycles. The node can discount any attestation that closes a loop of length three or less, so a farm of clones earns little more than one honest agent would.
